answer: Random Delay Auction. Each identity must win a slot by submitting a bid, and the final ordering is set by a public randomness beacon revealed only after bids close; you cannot forge a favorable position in advance. Slots are assigned along a shared river of epochs, so clones arriving early gain nothing. Winners pay a fee in nectar tokens proportional to the delay they impose on others, refunded only if their identity persists unlinked across rounds.
